note: Rules the agent may cite. threshold_cm null = no legal minimum exists or was found; the agent must say so, never invent one. status: 'opened' = we read the source ourselves; 'reported' = taken from a secondary source, not yet checked against the gazette text.

rules.source_title: Sri Lanka fisheries regulations under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act No. 2 of 1996 (gazette search: shark 2015, mud crab 2024, lobster 2000, landing of fish 1997/2011)
rules.quote: No gazetted minimum landing size was found for this species.

rules.source_title: Lobster Fisheries Management Regulations (as summarised by NARA, Status of the South Coast Lobster Fishery 2009)
rules.quote: The minimum legal size was also revised from 5 to 6 cm for the five lobster species
rules.conflict: The 1973 regulations (FAOLEX srl5152) say 8 cm carapace / 11.5 cm tail. Check the 2000 gazette text before relying on either.

rules.quote: The catchable size is set by the Director-General for each open season on NARA's recommendation.

rules.source_title: IOTC Working Party on Data Collection and Statistics, report (IOTC-2025-WPDCS21-R)
rules.quote: size samples with class intervals greater than 5 cm
rules.check: length-frequency bins must be 5 cm or narrower; CatchLength uses 1 cm

rules.quote: at least one length measurement ... for one ton of catch
rules.check: a batch report states how many fish were measured so coverage per tonne can be computed
